description: One row per skill a user is developing. A skill is a long-horizon capability track: it stores almost nothing itself and DERIVES its progress from habit entries, completed tasks, completed projects and completed campaigns. Import TWENTY-NINTH (no dependencies)
notes: Users live in Xano, not Baserow, so user_id is TEXT holding String(user.id) - never a link field. EVERY read filters on it.

This table deliberately stores NO progress. Practice days, streaks, cumulative volume and tier eligibility are all recomputed from habit entries at read time, so a skill can never disagree with the habit data it describes. The only progress here is `tier` - the highest tier the user has CLAIMED - and the frozen evidence for each claim.
started_at is load-bearing: every requirement is evaluated FROM this date. Without the clamp, starting a skill would instantly grant several tiers off existing history.

bindings and claims are long_text JSON blobs rather than columns. They are read and written together, and versioning a blob is cheaper than migrating columns - the same choice as campaigns.locked_rules_json and user_onboarding.

bindings holds: habitIds (the user's REAL habit row ids), taskRefs, projectRefs, campaignKeys. All four are ids of things that already exist elsewhere - this table owns none of them, and deleting a skill must never delete them.
campaignKeys is how a skill records being pursued as a campaign. ChallengeTerms is frozen at start on purpose, so it gains no skillId - the relationship lives on this side.
skill_id references the bundled catalogue in src/app/config/skill-catalogue/, not a table. The catalogue is code so tier thresholds can be reviewed and pinned to a release.
tier is a plain integer 0-5. 0 means started but nothing claimed yet.

skill_key.description: Client-generated stable key, skl_ prefixed. Primary field

user_id.description: Xano user id as a string. EVERY read filters on this

mode.description: The user's stated intent; campaignKeys in bindings is the actual record

started_at.description: Requirements are evaluated FROM this date

claims.description: JSON: SkillTierClaim[] - frozen evidence per claimed tier
